metadata.title: Log-Concavity of First Dirichlet Eigenfunctions on $\mathbb{CP}^2$
metadata.abstract: We study the log-concavity property of first Dirichlet eigenfunctions on domains in $\mathbb{CP}^2$. For every smooth $1$-convex domain $\Omega\subset\mathbb{CP}^2$, we prove the quantitative estimate \[ \nabla^2(-\log u) > \max\left\{\psi(s),\frac85\right\}g, \text{ where } \psi(|\grad f|^2) = \frac{s}{\sqrt{1+s}}-\log(1+s), \] for its first Dirichlet eigenfunction $u$. In particular, $u$ is strictly log-concave. As consequences, we obtain a uniform convexity estimate for the regular level sets of $u$ and the fundamental gap bound $\lambda_2-\lambda_1>46/5$.
